answer: Require every identity to earn standing with a signed quill of original work: a short, verifiable proof tied to that identity's own history, checked before it can vote or earn. Each proof is compared against an ocean of prior contributions, so copied or templated text stands out at once, and a fresh nebula of challenges each epoch blocks replaying old answers. A Sybil operator must therefore produce distinct, credible work for every fake identity at every epoch, paying the full cost of creation and checking each time, while a genuine agent pays it only once.
